patterns.note: A centered, minimal text-heavy layout dominates the hero section, featuring large, stacked headings that create a strong vertical rhythm.
Extremely large, thin sans-serif display headings are used for maximum impact, contrasting with smaller, regular weight body text and subtle uppercase labels.
The site employs a high-contrast dark mode, utilizing white text on a deep charcoal background for a sophisticated and focused aesthetic.
A full-screen pre-loader animation features a morphing logo with subtle color accents and blurred text elements, transitioning to the main content which slides up from the bottom of the viewport.
The primary content area is a single, tall, text-focused hero section that presents multiple distinct statements and product names in a stacked arrangement.

technique_notes: The page uses a full-screen pre-loader that displays a subtle logo animation and blurred text elements. Once loading is complete, the main content slides up from the bottom of the viewport to reveal the hero section.
Large display headings are stacked vertically, with smaller descriptive text positioned directly below them, creating a strong visual hierarchy through significant size and weight contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, thin sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) are used for impact, with smaller, regular weight body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp — all visible elements maintain crisp, sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy — generous vertical spacing between large text elements creates a sense of openness and allows each statement to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its bold, text-centric hero, using extremely large, thin typography and a dark, high-contrast palette to create a dramatic and sophisticated first impression, eschewing traditional imagery for pure textual impact.
